=== Notes ===
* Scott Church's Utah and Tatooine standings give first names only ("Aaron"); simone89's Day 2 bid list names Aaron Nelson for Utah States, and the Tatooine post is the next day's event of the same weekend.
* Tatooine Regionals: the top four was not played; Church wrote that he and Joe drew up to Aaron and Kevin and Kevin drew up to Aaron, so Aaron is entered 1st. The two Tatooine bids went to Joe Olson and Scott Church because Nelson had taken the Utah bye.
* Deck sides at Utah: the post gives "Mystril and WYS" without sides; WYS is entered as Light and Mystril as Dark.
